d:
Why grow up when you can colour the fur of a black dog - pink? What can you do if someone mistakes you for a totally different person? Have you ever fallen in love with an older girl? The tricky path that is an extra marital affair? Lastly, have you ever left everything for your love?
Dolly Singh graces us with her presence in this episode of Farzi Mushaira in which the shayars do an in depth emotional analysis of the questions you read above!
